# list archive

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:listArchive`](gmeow-listArchive.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/listArchive>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

An archive URI for the mailing list this message was distributed through (RFC 2369 List-Archive). Non-functional: multiple URIs may be listed.
